definitions.overshoot: max_k r_oracle(k) - M (population curve: sum of rescues / sum of drops; oracle = each case's own single-expert ranking)
definitions.late: M(<= L-5) - M: A0 'int_moe' minus 'all_moe'; > 0 = the last four MoE layers (at their clean values) work against the answer
definitions.N: cross-fitted negative single-expert mass: validation sum of the singles of the (layer, expert) pairs whose discovery all-case population effect is < 0, / drop
definitions.D: DLA of delta_e (final norm frozen at the corrupted run), same sets / bands, / drop
definitions.compensation: per case OLS y = DLA(last-4 MoE outputs) ~ x_A = DLA(all attention outputs) + x_M = DLA(MoE outputs below L-4 + embedding), logits; base run dla_rows (exact); CounterFact: addback_direct + clean-active expert DLA (approximation)
